description: This is a FastAPI route module defining authentication-related API endpoints for user registration, login, and profile retrieval including dependencies, request validation, and response models.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define authentication-related API endpoints.

methods.name: UserProfile register_endpoint(payload: RegisterRequest, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates a new user, and returns the user profile.

methods.name: TokenResponse login_endpoint( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), session: Session = Depends(get_session) )
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT token if successful.

methods.name: MeResponse me_endpoint(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves profile of the currently authenticated user.

ctags.name: login_endpoint
ctags.signature: ( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), session: Session = Depends(get_session) )

ctags.name: register_endpoint
ctags.pattern: /^def register_endpoint(payload: RegisterRequest, session: Session = Depends(get_session)) -> User/
